## Course Portal: IB Mathematics AI HL (Applications & Interpretation)
Welcome, students! This specialized section contains syllabus breakdowns, core study notes, targeted practice question banks, and actual exam past papers organized dynamically to optimize your learning and help you achieve a Grade 7.

## 1. Course Introduction

<p><strong>Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation (AI) Higher Level (HL)</strong> focuses on the practical applications of mathematics in real-world contexts, modeling economic and physical systems, and advanced statistics and probability. It emphasizes the extensive use of technology and graphing software to solve complex, data-driven problems. It is highly recommended for students planning to pursue Economics, Finance, Data Science, Business, or Applied Sciences at top universities.</p>

### Assessment Outline

<p>The IB Mathematics AI HL course is assessed through three final written examinations (80%) and an independent mathematical exploration task (20%). <strong>A graphic display calculator (GDC) is required for all written examinations:</strong></p>

### Syllabus Structure

<p>The syllabus is organized into five core topics consisting of both standard core content and advanced high-level extension topics (SL Core & HL Extensions):</p>

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Topic 1: Number and algebra
**1.1**: Operations in standard form<br/>
**1.2**: Arithmetic sequences and series<br/>
**1.3**: Geometric sequences and series<br/>
**1.4**: Financial applications<br/>
**1.5**: Laws of exponents with integer exponents<br/>
**1.6**: Approximation and significant figures<br/>
**1.7**: Amortization and annuities using technology<br/>
**1.8**: Systems of linear equations and polynomial solutions<br/>
**1.9**: Laws of logarithms [AHL]<br/>
**1.10**: Expressions with rational exponents [AHL]<br/>
**1.11**: Complex numbers in Cartesian form [AHL]<br/>
**1.12**: Polar and exponential forms of complex numbers [AHL]<br/>
**1.13**: Matrix operations and determinant [AHL]<br/>
**1.14**: Eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and diagonalization [AHL]

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Topic 2: Functions
**2.1**: Straight lines: equations, gradient, intercepts<br/>
**2.2**: Concept of a function: domain, range, notation<br/>
**2.3**: Graphs of functions<br/>
**2.4**: Key features of graphs<br/>
**2.5**: Financial and modeling applications<br/>
**2.6**: Mathematical modeling process<br/>
**2.7**: Composite and inverse functions [AHL]<br/>
**2.8**: Advanced graph transformations [AHL]<br/>
**2.9**: Modeling and fitting data [AHL]

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Topic 3: Geometry and trigonometry
**3.1**: Distance and midpoint in 3D space<br/>
**3.2**: Right-angled trigonometry<br/>
**3.3**: Sine and cosine rules, area of a triangle<br/>
**3.4**: Circle geometry: arc length and sector area<br/>
**3.5**: Equations of perpendicular bisectors<br/>
**3.6**: Voronoi diagrams<br/>
**3.7**: Logistic models [AHL]<br/>
**3.8**: Trigonometric definitions in unit circle [AHL]<br/>
**3.9**: Geometric transformations with matrices [AHL]<br/>
**3.10**: Concept of vectors [AHL]<br/>
**3.11**: Vector equations of lines [AHL]<br/>
**3.12**: Vector kinematics [AHL]<br/>
**3.13**: Scalar product and angle between vectors [AHL]<br/>
**3.14**: Graph theory: vertices, edges, degree [AHL]<br/>
**3.15**: Adjacency matrices and walks [AHL]<br/>
**3.16**: Algorithms for trees and cycles, MST, TSP [AHL]

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Topic 4: Statistics and probability
**4.1**: Population, sampling, discrete and continuous data<br/>
**4.2**: Data presentation: frequency distributions<br/>
**4.3**: Measures of central tendency and dispersion<br/>
**4.4**: Bivariate data, correlation, and regression<br/>
**4.5**: Probability of events, Venn and tree diagrams<br/>
**4.6**: Independent and mutually exclusive events<br/>
**4.7**: Discrete random variables and expectation<br/>
**4.8**: Binomial distribution<br/>
**4.9**: Normal distribution<br/>
**4.10**: Spearman's rank correlation coefficient<br/>
**4.11**: Chi-squared tests for independence and goodness of fit<br/>
**4.12**: Data collection design and sampling [AHL]<br/>
**4.13**: Non-linear regression models [AHL]<br/>
**4.14**: Linear transformations of random variables [AHL]<br/>
**4.15**: Combinations of normal variables [AHL]<br/>
**4.16**: Confidence intervals [AHL]<br/>
**4.17**: Poisson distribution [AHL]<br/>
**4.18**: Hypothesis testing and critical regions [AHL]

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Topic 5: Calculus
**5.1**: Introduction to limits<br/>
**5.2**: Increasing and decreasing functions<br/>
**5.3**: Derivative of power functions and basic rules<br/>
**5.4**: Tangents and normals equations<br/>
**5.5**: Indefinite integration as anti-differentiation<br/>
**5.6**: Stationary points and local maximum/minimum<br/>
**5.7**: Optimization problems<br/>
**5.8**: Trapezoidal rule for approximating areas<br/>
**5.9**: Derivatives of standard functions [AHL]<br/>
**5.10**: Second derivative and concavity [AHL]<br/>
**5.11**: Indefinite and definite integration [AHL]<br/>
**5.12**: Volumes of revolution [AHL]<br/>
**5.13**: Differential equations and modeling [AHL]<br/>
**5.14**: Slope fields [AHL]<br/>
**5.15**: Euler's method [AHL]<br/>
**5.16**: Coupled systems of differential equations [AHL]

:::

## 5. Past Papers Bank

*Search and filter actual past exam papers. Use the quick filter bar to locate papers by year, component, or document type:*

::: {.search-engine-box}
### IB Mathematics AI HL Past Papers List

```{=html}
<div class="card p-3 mb-4 shadow-sm" style="border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); background: var(--bs-card-bg, #ffffff);">
  <div class="card-body p-0">
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center flex-wrap gap-4">
      
      <!-- Year Select Dropdown -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2" style="min-width: 180px;">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Year:</span>
        <select id="filter-year" class="form-select form-select-sm" onchange="selectYearDropdown()" style="max-width: 130px; display: inline-block;">
          <option value="">All Years</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      
      <!-- Vertical Divider on desktop -->
      <div class="d-none d-md-block" style="border-left: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); height: 24px;"></div>
      
      <!-- Paper Pills -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 flex-grow-1">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Paper:</span>
        <div id="paper-pills" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary smart-paper-btn active" data-paper="" onclick="selectPaper(this)">All</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="p1" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 1</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="p2" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 2</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-paper-btn" data-paper="p3" onclick="selectPaper(this)">Paper 3</button>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="past-papers-table-container">
  <p><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> Loading past papers...</p>
</div>

<script>
let pastPapersDb = [];
let currentSelectedYear = '';
let currentSelectedPaper = '';
let currentPage = 1;
const pageSize = 10;
let filteredExams = [];
const currentLevel = 'ai_hl';

async function loadPastPapersDb() {
  if (pastPapersDb.length > 0) return pastPapersDb;
  try {
    const response = await fetch('past_papers_metadata.json');
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
    pastPapersDb = await response.json();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load past papers metadata:', error);
  }
  return pastPapersDb;
}

function populateYearDropdown(db, level) {
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById('filter-year');
  if (!yearSelect) return;

  const years = new Set();
  db.forEach(item => {
    if (item.level === level && item.year) {
      years.add(item.year.toString().trim());
    }
  });

  const sortedYears = Array.from(years).sort((a, b) => parseInt(b) - parseInt(a));

  yearSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Years</option>';
  sortedYears.forEach(year => {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = year;
    option.textContent = year;
    yearSelect.appendChild(option);
  });
}

function renderTableData() {
  const tableBody = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-body');
  const paginationContainer = document.getElementById('pagination-controls');
  if (!tableBody) return;

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredExams.length / pageSize);
  if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = Math.max(1, totalPages);

  const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
  const end = start + pageSize;
  const pageItems = filteredExams.slice(start, end);

  let html = '';
  pageItems.forEach(exam => {
    const seasonLabel = exam.season.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + exam.season.slice(1);
    const paperLabel = exam.paper.toUpperCase();
    const tzLabel = exam.timezone.toUpperCase();

    let qpHtml = '';
    if (exam.qp) {
      qpHtml = `<a href="${exam.qp}" target="_blank" title="Download Question Paper" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary bi bi-file-earmark-text" style="padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; width: 32px; height: 32px;"></a>`;
    } else {
      qpHtml = `<span class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">N/A</span>`;
    }

    let msHtml = '';
    if (exam.ms) {
      msHtml = `<a href="${exam.ms}" target="_blank" title="Download Mark Scheme" class="btn btn-sm btn-success bi bi-key" style="padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; width: 32px; height: 32px;"></a>`;
    } else {
      msHtml = `<span class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">N/A</span>`;
    }

    html += `
      <tr>
        <td><strong>${exam.year}</strong></td>
        <td><strong>${seasonLabel}</strong></td>
        <td><span class="badge badge-paper">${paperLabel}</span></td>
        <td><span class="badge badge-tz">${tzLabel}</span></td>
        <td style="text-align: center;">${qpHtml}</td>
        <td style="text-align: center;">${msHtml}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  });
  tableBody.innerHTML = html;

  // Render pagination controls
  if (totalPages <= 1) {
    paginationContainer.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  let pagHtml = '';
  pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" ${currentPage === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="changePage(${currentPage - 1})">Prev</button>`;
  
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    if (i === currentPage) {
      pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary active">${i}</button>`;
    } else {
      if (i === 1 || i === totalPages || Math.abs(i - currentPage) <= 1) {
        pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" onclick="changePage(${i})">${i}</button>`;
      } else if (i === 2 || i === totalPages - 1) {
        pagHtml += `<span class="text-muted px-1">...</span>`;
      }
    }
  }

  pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" ${currentPage === totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="changePage(${currentPage + 1})">Next</button>`;
  
  paginationContainer.innerHTML = pagHtml.replace(/(<span class="text-muted px-1">\.\.\.<\/span>\s*){2,}/g, '<span class="text-muted px-1">...</span>');
}

function changePage(page) {
  currentPage = page;
  renderTableData();
  document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
}

function applyFilters(level) {
  let filtered = pastPapersDb.filter(item => item.level === level);

  if (currentSelectedYear) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.year.toString() === currentSelectedYear);
  }
  if (currentSelectedPaper) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.paper.toLowerCase() === currentSelectedPaper.toLowerCase());
  }

  const exams = {};
  filtered.forEach(item => {
    const key = `${item.year}_${item.season}_${item.timezone}_${item.paper}`;
    if (!exams[key]) {
      exams[key] = {
        year: item.year,
        season: item.season,
        timezone: item.timezone,
        paper: item.paper,
        qp: null,
        ms: null
      };
    }
    if (item.type === 'qp') {
      exams[key].qp = item.google_drive_link;
    } else if (item.type === 'ms') {
      exams[key].ms = item.google_drive_link;
    }
  });

  filteredExams = Object.values(exams);
  filteredExams.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.year !== b.year) return parseInt(b.year) - parseInt(a.year);
    if (a.season !== b.season) return b.season.localeCompare(a.season); // 'winter' > 'summer'
    if (a.timezone !== b.timezone) return a.timezone.localeCompare(b.timezone);
    return a.paper.localeCompare(b.paper);
  });

  const container = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container');
  if (filteredExams.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; color: #9ca3af;"><i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> No matching past papers found.</p>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="table-wrapper">
      <table class="premium-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Year</th>
            <th>Season</th>
            <th>Paper</th>
            <th>Timezone</th>
            <th style="text-align: center; width: 80px;">QP</th>
            <th style="text-align: center; width: 80px;">MS</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="past-papers-table-body">
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center gap-2 mt-3" id="pagination-controls"></div>
  `;

  currentPage = 1;
  renderTableData();
}

function selectYearDropdown() {
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById('filter-year');
  currentSelectedYear = yearSelect.value || '';
  applyFilters(currentLevel);
}

function selectPaper(button) {
  currentSelectedPaper = button.getAttribute('data-paper') || '';

  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.smart-paper-btn');
  buttons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.remove('btn-primary', 'active');
    btn.classList.add('btn-outline-secondary');
  });
  button.classList.remove('btn-outline-secondary');
  button.classList.add('btn-primary', 'active');

  applyFilters(currentLevel);
}

async function initPastPapersTable() {
  const container = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container');
  const db = await loadPastPapersDb();
  
  if (!db || db.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" style="color: #ef4444;"></i> Error: Failed to load past papers database. Please try again later.</p>';
    return;
  }

  populateYearDropdown(db, currentLevel);
  applyFilters(currentLevel);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  initPastPapersTable();
});
</script>
```
:::
